title: User Auth
description: Email/password calls the real Firebase Auth SDK but fails server-side (fabricated API key). OTP is 100% fake — verifyOtp()'s check is effectively "any 6-digit string passes." Google Sign-In's native flow reliably fails (fabricated OAuth client) and falls back to a fully hardcoded fake profile. Most real registrations land under a local_uid_${email.hashCode()} fallback with no corresponding Firebase Auth account.
